protocol.selection_criterion: minimum arithmetic mean of fold RMSE
protocol.cv_std_definition: population SD across 5 folds; not a confidence interval
protocol.scaling: StandardScaler fitted inside every CV training fold
protocol.selection_unit: individual original numerical columns; CHAS remains binary
protocol.final_estimators: OLS for first four methods; regularized Lasso for Lasso

feature_curve_rules.Exhaustive: Lowest training-CV RMSE subset for each count.
feature_curve_rules.Forward: One subset per count on the greedy addition path.
feature_curve_rules.Backward: One subset per count on the greedy deletion path.
feature_curve_rules.RFECV: Training-only full RFE path; CV scores from fold-specific paths.
feature_curve_rules.Lasso: Group training-fit nonzero support counts; pick lowest CV RMSE alpha per observed count. Missing counts are not interpolated. Zero-support candidates omitted unless the CV-selected model has zero support.
feature_curve_rules.evaluation: All per-count models are fixed before test outcomes are accessed. Test curves are descriptive and never select a method or count.

protocol.interpretation: CV scores tune the selectors, not unbiased nested-CV scores. The 67-row holdout is from the 333 labeled Kaggle rows; do not choose a winning scheme from test scores.

# %% 1. 資料與固定切分
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys, hashlib, warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import sklearn, statsmodels.api as sm
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Lasso
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor
BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent if '__file__' in globals() else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(BASE))
from feature_selection import compare_selection_schemes, prepare_data, FEATURES, METHODS
RESULTS=BASE/'results'; RESULTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
train=pd.read_csv(BASE/'train.csv'); test=pd.read_csv(BASE/'test.csv')
assert train.shape==(333,15) and test.shape==(173,14)
assert not train.isna().any().any() and not test.isna().any().any()
assert train.ID.is_unique and test.ID.is_unique and set(train.ID).isdisjoint(test.ID)
X,y,tr,va=prepare_data(train)
print(f'Kaggle labeled: {len(train)}; unlabeled: {len(test)}; predictors: {len(FEATURES)}')
print(f'Internal training: {len(tr)}; held-out validation: {len(va)}; split seed=42')
print('MEDV is in historical USD 1,000; ID is excluded. All 13 original predictors retained for coursework.')

# %% 2. 五種特徵選擇（僅以 266 筆訓練與共用 5-fold CV 選擇）
# Exhaustive: 8191 subsets. Forward/Backward: greedy CV paths.
# RFECV: fold-specific coefficient elimination. Lasso: alpha grid 1e-4..10.
comparison=compare_selection_schemes(train,RESULTS)
details=json.loads((RESULTS/'selection_models.json').read_text())
protocol=json.loads((RESULTS/'selection_protocol.json').read_text())
chosen_method=str(comparison.iloc[0]['method'])  # sorted by CV RMSE, never validation RMSE
print(comparison[['method','n_features','features','cv_rmse','test_rmse','test_r_squared']].round(5).to_string(index=False))
print('Default submission method selected by TRAINING CV:',chosen_method)

# %% 3. 平均值與全特徵基準、OLS 診斷
def metrics(actual,pred):
    return {'RMSE':float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(actual,pred))),
            'MAE':float(mean_absolute_error(actual,pred)), 'R2':float(r2_score(actual,pred))}
baseline=[]
mean_pred=np.full(len(va),float(y.iloc[tr].mean()))
baseline.append({'model':'Mean baseline',**metrics(y.iloc[va],mean_pred)})
full=Pipeline([('scale',StandardScaler()),('model',LinearRegression())]).fit(X.iloc[tr],y.iloc[tr])
baseline.append({'model':'Full OLS (13 features)',**metrics(y.iloc[va],full.predict(X.iloc[va]))})
pd.DataFrame(baseline).to_csv(RESULTS/'baseline_metrics.csv',index=False)
scale=full.named_steps['scale']; design=sm.add_constant(pd.DataFrame(scale.transform(X.iloc[tr]),columns=FEATURES),has_constant='add')
ols=sm.OLS(y.iloc[tr].to_numpy(),design).fit(cov_type='HC3')
ci=ols.conf_int()
coefficients=pd.DataFrame({'feature':ols.params.index,'coefficient':ols.params.values,'CI95_low':ci.iloc[:,0].values,'CI95_high':ci.iloc[:,1].values,'p_value':ols.pvalues.values})
coefficients.to_csv(RESULTS/'ols_coefficients.csv',index=False)
(RESULTS/'ols_summary.txt').write_text(ols.summary().as_text())
vif=pd.DataFrame({'feature':FEATURES,'VIF':[variance_inflation_factor(design.to_numpy(),i+1) for i in range(len(FEATURES))]}).sort_values('VIF',ascending=False)
vif.to_csv(RESULTS/'vif.csv',index=False)
resid=y.iloc[va].to_numpy()-full.predict(X.iloc[va])
print(pd.DataFrame(baseline).round(4).to_string(index=False))
print('Full OLS training adjusted R2:',ols.rsquared_adj)
print('BP p:',het_breuschpagan(ols.resid,design)[1], 'JB p:',stats.jarque_bera(ols.resid).pvalue)

# %% 4. 以全部 333 筆重新擬合，產生 173 筆 Kaggle 提交預測
# Keep features/alpha chosen in section 2; never use validation outcomes to select a method.
submission_models={}; kaggle_predictions=[]
for method in METHODS:
    info=details[method]
    cols=FEATURES if method=='Lasso' else info['selected_features']
    reg=Lasso(alpha=info['alpha'],max_iter=100000,tol=1e-8) if method=='Lasso' else LinearRegression()
    pipe=Pipeline([('scale',StandardScaler()),('model',reg)]).fit(X[cols],y)
    scaler=pipe.named_steps['scale']; fitted=pipe.named_steps['model']
    raw=fitted.coef_/scaler.scale_
    model={'raw_intercept':float(fitted.intercept_-np.dot(raw,scaler.mean_)),
           'raw_coefficients':dict(zip(cols,raw.tolist())), 'selected_features':info['selected_features'],
           'alpha':info['alpha'], 'trained_rows':333}
    submission_models[method]=model
    predictions=pipe.predict(test[cols])
    exported=np.array([model['raw_intercept']+sum(c*row[f] for f,c in model['raw_coefficients'].items()) for _,row in test.iterrows()])
    assert np.allclose(exported,predictions,atol=1e-9)
    submission=pd.DataFrame({'ID':test.ID,'medv':predictions})
    assert len(submission)==173 and np.isfinite(submission.medv).all()
    submission.to_csv(RESULTS/f'submission_{method.lower()}.csv',index=False)
    if method==chosen_method:submission.to_csv(BASE/'submission.csv',index=False)
    kaggle_predictions.extend({'method':method,'ID':int(i),'predicted_medv':float(p)} for i,p in zip(test.ID,predictions))
(RESULTS/'submission_models.json').write_text(json.dumps(submission_models,indent=2))
pd.DataFrame(kaggle_predictions).to_csv(RESULTS/'kaggle_predictions.csv',index=False)
print(f'Generated 5 submission files, each 173 rows; default submission.csv = {chosen_method}.')
print('No Kaggle test targets used; no leaderboard score claimed; no automatic competition submission.')

# %% 5. 圖表、可重現摘要與網站資料
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':10,'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False,'figure.facecolor':'#f5f6f8','savefig.dpi':150})
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.5)); ordered=comparison.set_index('method').loc[METHODS]
ax[0].bar(METHODS,ordered.cv_rmse,yerr=ordered.cv_rmse_std,capsize=4,color='#168974')
ax[0].set(title='Training 5-fold CV RMSE (SD)',ylabel='RMSE (historical USD 1,000)')
ax[1].bar(METHODS,ordered.test_rmse,color='#367de9');ax[1].set(title='67-row held-out validation RMSE',ylabel='RMSE (historical USD 1,000)')
for a in ax:a.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=20)
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(RESULTS/'comparison.png');plt.close(fig)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.2));pred=full.predict(X.iloc[va])
ax[0].scatter(y.iloc[va],pred,color='#168974',alpha=.7);ax[0].plot([0,55],[0,55],'--',color='#b88b4a');ax[0].set(title='Full OLS: actual vs predicted',xlabel='Actual medv',ylabel='Predicted medv')
ax[1].scatter(pred,resid,color='#367de9',alpha=.7);ax[1].axhline(0,color='#b88b4a',linestyle='--');ax[1].set(title='Full OLS: validation residuals',xlabel='Predicted medv',ylabel='Actual - predicted')
stats.probplot(resid,plot=ax[2]);ax[2].set_title('Validation residual Q-Q')
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(RESULTS/'diagnostics.png');plt.close(fig)
corr=train.drop(columns='ID').corr()
corr.to_csv(RESULTS/'correlation.csv')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.3));ax[0].hist(train.medv,bins=23,color='#168974',edgecolor='white');ax[0].set(title='Labeled medv distribution',xlabel='Historical USD 1,000',ylabel='Observations')
ax[1].scatter(train.rm,train.medv,color='#367de9',alpha=.55,s=15);ax[1].set(title=f'Rooms vs medv (r={corr.loc["rm","medv"]:.3f})',xlabel='Average rooms',ylabel='medv (USD 1,000)')
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(RESULTS/'eda.png');plt.close(fig)
summary={'labeled_rows':333,'kaggle_test_rows':173,'train_rows':len(tr),'validation_rows':len(va),
         'features':FEATURES,'exhaustive_subsets':8191,'cv_folds':5,'seed':42,'chosen_method_by_cv':chosen_method,
         'target':'medv','target_unit':'historical USD 1,000','capped_target_count':int((train.medv==50).sum()),
         'ols_adjusted_r2':float(ols.rsquared_adj),'BP_p':float(het_breuschpagan(ols.resid,design)[1]),
         'JB_p':float(stats.jarque_bera(ols.resid).pvalue),
         'versions':{'numpy':np.__version__,'pandas':pd.__version__,'scikit-learn':sklearn.__version__,'statsmodels':sm.__version__,'matplotlib':matplotlib.__version__}}
(RESULTS/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
def rec(path):return json.loads(pd.read_csv(path).to_json(orient='records',double_precision=14))
payload={'dataset':rec(BASE/'train.csv'),'kaggle_test':rec(BASE/'test.csv'),
         'selection':rec(RESULTS/'selection_comparison.csv'),'curves':rec(RESULTS/'selection_feature_curves.csv'),
         'history':rec(RESULTS/'selection_cv_history.csv'),'predictions':rec(RESULTS/'selection_predictions.csv'),
         'curve_predictions':rec(RESULTS/'selection_curve_predictions.csv'),
         'models':details,'submission_models':submission_models,'protocol':protocol,
         'summary':summary,'vif':rec(RESULTS/'vif.csv'),'coefficients':rec(RESULTS/'ols_coefficients.csv'),
         'baseline':baseline,'source':(BASE/'analysis.py').read_text(),'selection_source':(BASE/'feature_selection.py').read_text(),
         'kaggle_predictions':kaggle_predictions,'provenance':json.loads((BASE/'provenance.json').read_text())}
(BASE/'web_data.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False))
print('Completed analysis, feature-count curves, diagnostics and browser model exports.')

"""Five train-only feature selectors, evaluated on the original shared holdout."""
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
import json

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_selection import RFE, RFECV
from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.linear_model import Lasso, LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, KFold, cross_val_score, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

FEATURES = ['crim', 'zn', 'indus', 'chas', 'nox', 'rm', 'age', 'dis', 'rad', 'tax', 'ptratio', 'black', 'lstat']
METHODS = ['Exhaustive', 'Forward', 'Backward', 'RFECV', 'Lasso']
ALPHAS = np.logspace(-4, 1, 61)
SCORING = 'neg_root_mean_squared_error'


def prepare_data(df):
    """Kaggle labeled data only: retain IDs for traceability, never as a feature."""
    X = df[FEATURES].astype(float).copy()
    train_rows, test_rows = train_test_split(df.index.to_numpy(),
                                            test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
    return X, df.medv, train_rows, test_rows


def linear_pipeline():
    # A fresh scaler is fitted inside each CV fold, including RFECV elimination.
    return Pipeline([('scale', StandardScaler()), ('model', LinearRegression())])


def compare_selection_schemes(df, output_dir):
    """Choose features/hyperparameters on 266 training rows; then score 67 validation rows.

    Exhaustive/Forward/Backward evaluate fixed subsets by mean fold RMSE.
    RFECV scores fold-specific elimination subsets for each feature count.
    Lasso tunes alpha and keeps the regularized estimator for final prediction.
    CV scores select a model; they are not nested-CV estimates of generalization.
    """
    out = Path(output_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    X, y, train_rows, test_rows = prepare_data(df)
    X_train, y_train = X.loc[train_rows], y.loc[train_rows]
    folds = list(KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42).split(X_train))
    cache, history, fitted = {}, [], {}
    columns = list(X.columns)

    def evaluate(features):
        # Canonical order makes subset caching and tie-breaking deterministic.
        features = tuple(f for f in columns if f in features)
        if features not in cache:
            rmses = -cross_val_score(linear_pipeline(), X_train[list(features)],
                                    y_train, cv=folds, scoring=SCORING, n_jobs=1)
            cache[features] = {'features': features, 'cv_rmse': float(rmses.mean()),
                               'cv_rmse_std': float(rmses.std()),
                               'fold_rmse': rmses.tolist()}
        return cache[features]

    def best(candidates):
        return min(candidates, key=lambda c: (c['cv_rmse'], len(c['features']), c['features']))

    def record(method, stage, candidate):
        row = {'method': method, 'stage': stage, 'n_features': len(candidate['features']),
               'features': ' | '.join(candidate['features']),
               'cv_rmse': candidate['cv_rmse'], 'cv_rmse_std': candidate['cv_rmse_std'],
               'alpha': np.nan, 'chosen': False}
        for i, score in enumerate(candidate['fold_rmse']):
            row[f'fold_{i + 1}_rmse'] = score
        history.append(row)

    # 1. All 2**13 - 1 = 8191 nonempty subsets, scored using training data only.
    exhaustive = []
    for k in range(1, len(columns) + 1):
        for subset in combinations(columns, k):
            candidate = evaluate(subset)
            exhaustive.append(candidate)
            record('Exhaustive', k, candidate)
    print('Exhaustive finished: 8191 subsets', flush=True)
    selections = {'Exhaustive': best(exhaustive)}

    # 2. Greedily add one feature at each stage; choose the best size along the path.
    current, forward_path = (), []
    for k in range(1, len(columns) + 1):
        candidates = [evaluate(current + (f,)) for f in columns if f not in current]
        for candidate in candidates:
            record('Forward', k, candidate)
        winner = best(candidates)
        forward_path.append(winner)
        current = winner['features']
    selections['Forward'] = best(forward_path)

    # 3. Start with all features; greedily remove one, then choose the best path size.
    current = tuple(columns)
    backward_path = [evaluate(current)]
    record('Backward', len(columns), backward_path[0])
    while len(current) > 1:
        candidates = [evaluate(tuple(f for f in current if f != removed))
                      for removed in current]
        for candidate in candidates:
            record('Backward', len(current) - 1, candidate)
        winner = best(candidates)
        backward_path.append(winner)
        current = winner['features']
    selections['Backward'] = best(backward_path)

    for method, candidate in selections.items():
        features = list(candidate['features'])
        estimator = linear_pipeline().fit(X_train[features], y_train)
        fitted[method] = (estimator, features, candidate['cv_rmse'],
                          candidate['cv_rmse_std'], None)
        for row in history:
            if row['method'] == method and row['features'] == ' | '.join(features):
                row['chosen'] = True

    # 4. RFE's coefficient magnitudes are on standardized inputs at every fit.
    selector = RFECV(linear_pipeline(), step=1, min_features_to_select=1,
                     cv=folds, scoring=SCORING, n_jobs=1,
                     importance_getter='named_steps.model.coef_').fit(X_train, y_train)
    rf_features = X.columns[selector.support_].tolist()
    rf_results = selector.cv_results_
    rf_index = list(rf_results['n_features']).index(selector.n_features_)
    rf_fold_details = []
    for j, k in enumerate(rf_results['n_features']):
        row = {'method': 'RFECV', 'stage': int(k), 'n_features': int(k),
               # The actual subset can differ across folds; do not label it as fixed.
               'features': '(fold-specific RFE subsets)',
               'cv_rmse': float(-rf_results['mean_test_score'][j]),
               'cv_rmse_std': float(rf_results['std_test_score'][j]),
               'alpha': np.nan, 'chosen': j == rf_index}
        for fold in range(len(folds)):
            row[f'fold_{fold + 1}_rmse'] = float(-rf_results[f'split{fold}_test_score'][j])
            support = rf_results[f'split{fold}_support'][j]
            rf_fold_details.append({'fold': fold + 1, 'n_features': int(k),
                                    'features': X.columns[support].tolist()})
        history.append(row)
    fitted['RFECV'] = (selector.estimator_, rf_features,
                       float(-rf_results['mean_test_score'][rf_index]),
                       float(rf_results['std_test_score'][rf_index]), None)

    # 5. Tune Lasso alpha using the same folds; never refit unregularized OLS afterward.
    lasso = GridSearchCV(
        Pipeline([('scale', StandardScaler()),
                  ('model', Lasso(max_iter=100000, tol=1e-8))]),
        {'model__alpha': ALPHAS}, cv=folds, scoring=SCORING, n_jobs=1,
        refit=True, error_score='raise').fit(X_train, y_train)
    lasso_results = lasso.cv_results_
    for j, alpha in enumerate(ALPHAS):
        row = {'method': 'Lasso', 'stage': j + 1, 'n_features': np.nan,
               'features': '(nonzero support varies by fold)',
               'cv_rmse': float(-lasso_results['mean_test_score'][j]),
               'cv_rmse_std': float(lasso_results['std_test_score'][j]),
               'alpha': float(alpha), 'chosen': j == lasso.best_index_}
        for fold in range(len(folds)):
            row[f'fold_{fold + 1}_rmse'] = float(-lasso_results[f'split{fold}_test_score'][j])
        history.append(row)
    lasso_model = lasso.best_estimator_
    support = lasso_model.named_steps['model'].coef_ != 0
    lasso_features = X.columns[support].tolist()
    fitted['Lasso'] = (lasso_model, lasso_features, float(-lasso.best_score_),
                       float(lasso_results['std_test_score'][lasso.best_index_]),
                       float(lasso.best_params_['model__alpha']))

    # Define every per-count model using training data only. The web chart must
    # follow the selected method rather than reuse the manual reference curve.
    curve_models = []

    def add_curve(method, model, selected, cv_rmse, cv_std, alpha=None):
        curve_models.append({'method': method, 'model': model,
                             'selected': list(selected), 'cv_rmse': cv_rmse,
                             'cv_rmse_std': cv_std, 'alpha': alpha})

    paths = {
        'Exhaustive': [best([c for c in exhaustive if len(c['features']) == k])
                       for k in range(1, len(columns) + 1)],
        'Forward': forward_path,
        'Backward': list(reversed(backward_path)),
    }
    for method, path in paths.items():
        for candidate in path:
            selected = list(candidate['features'])
            model = linear_pipeline().fit(X_train[selected], y_train)
            add_curve(method, model, selected, candidate['cv_rmse'], candidate['cv_rmse_std'])
    for j, k in enumerate(rf_results['n_features']):
        rfe = RFE(linear_pipeline(), n_features_to_select=int(k), step=1,
                  importance_getter='named_steps.model.coef_').fit(X_train, y_train)
        add_curve('RFECV', rfe.estimator_, X.columns[rfe.support_].tolist(),
                  float(-rf_results['mean_test_score'][j]),
                  float(rf_results['std_test_score'][j]))
    lasso_by_count = {}
    for j, alpha in enumerate(ALPHAS):
        model = clone(lasso_model).set_params(model__alpha=float(alpha)).fit(X_train, y_train)
        selected = X.columns[model.named_steps['model'].coef_ != 0].tolist()
        k = len(selected)
        # Show observed nonempty supports, without inventing missing feature counts.
        if k == 0 and lasso_features:
            continue
        cv_rmse = float(-lasso_results['mean_test_score'][j])
        if k not in lasso_by_count or cv_rmse < lasso_by_count[k]['cv_rmse']:
            lasso_by_count[k] = {'model': model, 'selected': selected, 'cv_rmse': cv_rmse,
                                'cv_std': float(lasso_results['std_test_score'][j]),
                                'alpha': float(alpha)}
    for k in sorted(lasso_by_count):
        c = lasso_by_count[k]
        add_curve('Lasso', c['model'], c['selected'], c['cv_rmse'], c['cv_std'], c['alpha'])

    # All selection is finished before the first access to test outcomes.
    rows, predictions, model_details = [], [], {}
    for method in METHODS:
        model, features, cv_rmse, cv_std, alpha = fitted[method]
        # Lasso is fitted on all columns; zero coefficients perform selection.
        input_features = columns if method == 'Lasso' else features
        test_input = X.loc[test_rows, input_features]
        # sklearn RFE fits its final estimator on an ndarray after masking columns.
        pred = model.predict(test_input.to_numpy() if method == 'RFECV' else test_input)
        rows.append({'method': method, 'n_features': len(features),
                     'features': ' | '.join(features), 'cv_rmse': cv_rmse,
                     'cv_rmse_std': cv_std, 'test_rmse': float(np.sqrt(
                         mean_squared_error(y.loc[test_rows], pred))),
                     'test_r_squared': float(r2_score(y.loc[test_rows], pred)),
                     'alpha': alpha})
        predictions.extend({'method': method, 'row_id': int(row),
                            'actual_medv': float(y.loc[row]), 'predicted_medv': float(p),
                            'residual': float(y.loc[row] - p)}
                           for row, p in zip(test_rows, pred))
        scale, reg = model.named_steps['scale'], model.named_steps['model']
        raw_coefs = reg.coef_ / scale.scale_
        model_details[method] = {
            'selected_features': features, 'input_features': input_features, 'alpha': alpha,
            'scaled_coefficients': dict(zip(input_features, reg.coef_.tolist())),
            'scaler_mean': dict(zip(input_features, scale.mean_.tolist())),
            'scaler_scale': dict(zip(input_features, scale.scale_.tolist())),
            'raw_coefficients': dict(zip(input_features, raw_coefs.tolist())),
            'raw_intercept': float(reg.intercept_ - np.dot(raw_coefs, scale.mean_))}
    comparison = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(['cv_rmse', 'n_features', 'method']).reset_index(drop=True)
    comparison.to_csv(out / 'selection_comparison.csv', index=False)
    pd.DataFrame(predictions).to_csv(out / 'selection_predictions.csv', index=False)
    pd.DataFrame(history).to_csv(out / 'selection_cv_history.csv', index=False)
    (out / 'selection_models.json').write_text(json.dumps(model_details, indent=2))
    curve_rows, curve_predictions = [], []
    for c in curve_models:
        method, selected = c['method'], c['selected']
        inputs = columns if method == 'Lasso' else selected
        test_input = X.loc[test_rows, inputs]
        pred = c['model'].predict(test_input.to_numpy() if method == 'RFECV' else test_input)
        chosen = (selected == fitted[method][1] and c['alpha'] == fitted[method][4])
        curve_rows.append({'method': method, 'n_features': len(selected),
                           'features': ' | '.join(selected), 'cv_rmse': c['cv_rmse'],
                           'cv_rmse_std': c['cv_rmse_std'], 'alpha': c['alpha'],
                           'chosen': chosen,
                           'test_rmse': float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y.loc[test_rows], pred))),
                           'test_r_squared': float(r2_score(y.loc[test_rows], pred))})
        curve_predictions.extend({'method': method, 'n_features': len(selected),
                                  'row_id': int(i), 'actual_medv': float(y.loc[i]),
                                  'predicted_medv': float(p)}
                                 for i, p in zip(test_rows, pred))
    pd.DataFrame(curve_rows).to_csv(out / 'selection_feature_curves.csv', index=False)
    pd.DataFrame(curve_predictions).to_csv(out / 'selection_curve_predictions.csv', index=False)
    (out / 'selection_protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps({
        'test_size': 0.2, 'split_random_state': 42, 'row_id_is_zero_based': True,
        'train_rows': train_rows.tolist(), 'test_rows': test_rows.tolist(),
        'cv_n_splits': 5, 'cv_shuffle': True, 'cv_random_state': 42,
        'selection_criterion': 'minimum arithmetic mean of fold RMSE',
        'cv_std_definition': 'population SD across 5 folds; not a confidence interval',
        'scaling': 'StandardScaler fitted inside every CV training fold',
        'excluded_features': ['ID'], 'feature_columns': columns,
        'selection_unit': 'individual original numerical columns; CHAS remains binary',
        'lasso_alpha_grid': ALPHAS.tolist(), 'lasso_support_rule': 'coefficient != 0',
        'final_estimators': 'OLS for first four methods; regularized Lasso for Lasso',
        'folds': [{'fold': i + 1, 'train_rows': train_rows[tr].tolist(),
                   'validation_rows': train_rows[val].tolist()}
                  for i, (tr, val) in enumerate(folds)],
        'rfecv_fold_subsets': rf_fold_details,
        'rfecv_final_ranking': dict(zip(columns, selector.ranking_.tolist())),
        'selection_paths': {'Forward': [list(c['features']) for c in forward_path],
                            'Backward': [list(c['features']) for c in backward_path]},
        'feature_curve_rules': {
            'Exhaustive': 'Lowest training-CV RMSE subset for each count.',
            'Forward': 'One subset per count on the greedy addition path.',
            'Backward': 'One subset per count on the greedy deletion path.',
            'RFECV': 'Training-only full RFE path; CV scores from fold-specific paths.',
            'Lasso': 'Group training-fit nonzero support counts; pick lowest CV RMSE alpha '
                     'per observed count. Missing counts are not interpolated. '
                     'Zero-support candidates omitted unless the CV-selected model has zero support.',
            'evaluation': 'All per-count models are fixed before test outcomes are accessed. '
                          'Test curves are descriptive and never select a method or count.'},
        'interpretation': 'CV scores tune the selectors, not unbiased nested-CV scores. '
                          'The 67-row holdout is from the 333 labeled Kaggle rows; '
                          'do not choose a winning scheme from test scores.'}, indent=2))
    return comparison


def plot_selection_comparison(comparison, output_dir):
    """Display in method order; no test-based method ranking."""
    data = comparison.set_index('method').loc[METHODS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    axes[0].bar(data.index, data.cv_rmse, yerr=data.cv_rmse_std, capsize=4)
    axes[0].set(title='Selection CV RMSE (5 folds; error bars = SD)', ylabel='RMSE')
    axes[1].bar(data.index, data.test_rmse)
    axes[1].set(title='Shared 67-row validation RMSE', ylabel='RMSE')
    for axis in axes:
        axis.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=20)
        axis.set_ylim(bottom=0)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(Path(output_dir) / 'selection_comparison.png', dpi=150)
    return fig
